title: 为月球停掉载人飞行：值吗？，CEO必须这么干
speaker: Dave Lim

segments.en: The world became familiar with Blue Origin through New Shepherd, the smaller form factor launch system.
segments.zh: 世界通过新谢泼德这个较小型的发射系统认识了蓝色起源。

segments.en: And the first focus of that was kind of space tourism, going to a pretty low altitude relatively speaking, for a few minutes of waitlessness.
segments.zh: 最初的重点是太空旅游，飞到相对较低的高度，体验几分钟的失重。

segments.en: And of course, I was in Van Horn, Texas, when Jeff Bezos himself went up, but you took the decision to halt that program.
segments.zh: 当然，当杰夫·贝索斯亲自升空时，我在德克萨斯州的范霍恩，但你决定暂停该项目。

segments.en: In large part to focus on Blue's participation in getting America back to the moon.
segments.zh: 很大程度上是为了专注于蓝色起源参与美国重返月球的任务。

segments.en: And so in the first instance, Dave, what has the result of that decision been?
segments.zh: 那么首先，戴夫，这个决定的结果如何？

segments.en: Have you been able to accelerate that other program, the lunar program?
segments.zh: 你是否能够加速另一个项目，即月球项目？

segments.en: How have you moved and reassigned resource and people to fulfill that ambition?
segments.zh: 你是如何调动和重新分配资源和人员来实现这一雄心的？
